text:
Aisha Khan: Hi folks, on my first day and trying to open Redwood Console (prod) to follow the quickstart. After SSO I get a blank UI and devtools shows a 403 on /api/flags.
Aisha Khan: curl returns:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags
# {"error":"forbidden","message":"Access denied: role_missing"}
```
Aisha Khan: Wondering whether I missed a step (VPN, IP allowlist, or role) or need a service account for demos. Who should I ping?
Riley (Infra): Welcome Aisha! :wave: For most new hires we grant org-level console-read first. If you see role_missing it's almost always missing the console role. Share your SSO email and I'll kick off a JIT.
Aisha Khan: aisha.khan@redwood.ai thanks Riley.
Onboarding Bot: Access request created: ONB-3056 by Riley (Infra). Approvers: eng-leads, infra. Link: https://redwood.internal/onboard/ONB-3056
Riley (Infra): Also note: if you're on a home network some prod endpoints are behind a maintenance IP allowlist. The UI itself should work after role grant but flagged APIs may still be restricted. If the JIT doesn't fix it I'll open a temporary IP rule.
Ben (Security): Hi @Aisha 1 (2FA reminder) 1 -- make sure you completed the SSO device approval step. We auto-block tokens that haven't been approved on first login. If you need the IP allowlist route, include your public IP and reason in the ticket.
Aisha Khan: I approved the device prompt. JIT shows pending.
Riley (Infra): Approved the JIT. Try reloading. If flags endpoint still 403, run this and paste the request id:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags 2>&1 | grep 'x-request-id'
```
Aisha Khan: Got x-request-id: rq_2b7d9a. Flags still 403.
Riley (Infra): Thanks. I'm flipping the allowlist for your IP briefly. If you're comfortable, you can also use the bastion tunnel: 
```
ssh -NL 8000:console.internal:443 riley@bastion.redwood
# then open https://localhost:8000 in browser and re-login
```
Nora (DevEx): If you need to demo flag toggles for your intro, I can create a temp role with flags:write for 1 hour. Just DM me the flag key and time.
Aisha Khan: Tunnel worked and UI loads now. I see staging flags but prod flags still 403 for some keys.
Riley (Infra): Prod has a tighter project scoping. I added you to org:eng console-read-scoped for the project. Try again without the tunnel.
Aisha Khan: ✅ Prod flags visible now. Thanks everyone.
Ben (Security): If you later need a service account for CI include a justification and an expiry (we prefer 30/90 days) in the template: https://redwood.internal/security/service-account-request.md. Read-only SA are auto-approved with 90-day expiry.
Aisha Khan: Filing a follow-up to request a short-lived service account for my demo CI job. Appreciate the quick help :heart:
